{{Quote|Chief Sergeant Sukko was among those who scaled Mittoblade's magnetic cliff, where he helped trigger the collapse of the Clowse Glowstack despite losing both legs to a Doshan raider.|Supreme Chancellor Nagratha|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
'''Mittoblade''' was an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] celestial body. During the [[Waymancy Storm]], [[Chief sergeant|Chief Sergeant]] [[Saens Sukko]] was among a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] group that scaled a [[Mittoblade's magnetic cliff|magnetic cliff]] on Mittoblade. There, Sukko helped trigger the destruction of the [[Clowse Glowstack]], associated with the Republic's enemy, the [[Signatories of Waymancy]]. The [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Ruthbert Ozzel]] eventually came to be known as the "Savior of Mittoblade."

==Description==
Mittoblade was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="Author's Cut" /> located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Mittoblade system/Legends|Mittoblade system]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
{{Quote|I am not the first Ozzel to rise within the naval ranks. Perhaps you have read of Ruthbert Ozzel, the Savior of Mittoblade, ''[&hellip;]''<nowiki />|Captain Kendal Ozzel, ''Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide''|<ref name="IH">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Waymancy Storm]] conflict<ref name="Author's Cut" /> of [[7811 BBY]],<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Mittoblade was the site of a [[Mittoblade's magnetic cliff|magnetic cliff]], where the structure known as the [[Clowse Glowstack]] was situated. The latter was associated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] enemy in the war, the [[Signatories of Waymancy]]. During that conflict, a group of Republic agents, including [[Chief sergeant|Chief Sergeant]] [[Saens Sukko]], scaled the [[Magnet/Legends|magnetic]] cliff. There, Sukko assisted in initiating the [[Collapse of the Clowse Glowstack|collapse]] of the Clowse Glowstack, although the [[Republic officer/Legends|officer]] lost both of his [[Limb/Legends|legs]] to a [[Doshan]] raider in the process.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

The Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Nagratha]] later noted the events at Mittoblade as one of the heroic moments of the war at a speech delivered on the [[25th anniversary of Victory in the Waymancy Storm]] in [[7786 BBY]].<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Ruthbert Ozzel]], a [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] and ancestor of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]<ref name="IH" /> [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|433|Ozzel, Admiral Kendal}}</ref> [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]], eventually came to be known as the "Savior of Mittoblade," a fact which Kendal, holding the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] at the time, noted in the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', an [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] manual published<ref name="IH" /> by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'' is presented as an [[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide|in-universe document]] published nineteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which corresponds to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Mittoblade was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned the astronomical object, authored by [[Daniel Wallace]], was cut before the book's release.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

The information regarding Mittoblade was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Mittoblade [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square K-8.<ref name="EAOC" />
